name: Green Dot Corporation
summary: Green Dot Corporation, a financial technology and registered bank holding company, provides various financial services to consumers and businesses in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Consumer Services, Business to Business Services, and Money Movement Services. It provides deposit account programs, including consumer and small business checking account products, network-branded reloadable prepaid debit cards and gift cards, and secured credit programs.
